```{julia}
using DataFrames, Statistics

function curves_best_vs_other_locf(acc_log::DataFrame, best_agent::Dict{Int,Int})
    # task columns: task_1, task_2, ...
    task_cols = filter(c -> occursin(r"^task_\d+$", String(c)), names(acc_log))
    task_nums = parse.(Int, replace.(String.(task_cols), r"^task_" => ""))

    agents = sort(unique(acc_log.bee1_id))
    nA = length(agents)
    agent_to_idx = Dict(a => i for (i,a) in enumerate(agents))

    # We'll maintain current accuracies: state[agent_index, task_index]
    # Initialize as NaN until an agent appears the first time.
    nT = length(task_cols)
    state = fill(NaN, nA, nT)

    # sort by time (important!)
    df = sort(acc_log, :time)

    # output arrays
    times = Float64[]
    mean_best  = Float64[]; std_best  = Float64[]
    mean_other = Float64[]; std_other = Float64[]

    for r in eachrow(df)
        t = r.time
        a = r.bee1_id
        ai = agent_to_idx[a]

        # Update this agent's full task vector at this time (row has all task_* cols)
        for (j, tc) in enumerate(task_cols)
            state[ai, j] = r[tc]
        end

        # Now compute best vs other samples using CURRENT state (LOCF)
        best_vals  = Float64[]
        other_vals = Float64[]

        for (j, k) in enumerate(task_nums)
            a_best = best_agent[k]
            bi = agent_to_idx[a_best]

            vbest = state[bi, j]
            # Only use if we've seen that best agent at least once (not NaN)
            isfinite(vbest) && push!(best_vals, vbest)

            # others
            for (a2, i2) in agent_to_idx
                a2 == a_best && continue
                v = state[i2, j]
                isfinite(v) && push!(other_vals, v)
            end
        end

        # store one point per event-time (same times as in your log)
        push!(times, t)

        # handle early times where not enough data exists yet
        if isempty(best_vals)
            push!(mean_best, NaN); push!(std_best, NaN)
        else
            push!(mean_best, mean(best_vals))
            push!(std_best,  std(best_vals))
        end

        if isempty(other_vals)
            push!(mean_other, NaN); push!(std_other, NaN)
        else
            push!(mean_other, mean(other_vals))
            push!(std_other,  std(other_vals))
        end
    end

    return DataFrame(
        time = times,
        mean_best = mean_best,   std_best = std_best,
        mean_other = mean_other, std_other = std_other
    )
end
```

```{julia}
curves = curves_best_vs_other_locf(elog, best_agent)
fig = Figure(resolution=(900, 500))
ax = Axis(fig[1,1], xlabel="time", ylabel="accuracy")

# filter finite points (early on, NaNs are expected)
ok_best  = isfinite.(curves.mean_best) .& isfinite.(curves.std_best)
ok_other = isfinite.(curves.mean_other) .& isfinite.(curves.std_other)

t = curves.time

band!(ax, t[ok_best],
        curves.mean_best[ok_best] .- curves.std_best[ok_best],
        curves.mean_best[ok_best] .+ curves.std_best[ok_best],
        alpha=0.25)
lines!(ax, t[ok_best], curves.mean_best[ok_best], linewidth=3, label="best-per-task")

band!(ax, t[ok_other],
        curves.mean_other[ok_other] .- curves.std_other[ok_other],
        curves.mean_other[ok_other] .+ curves.std_other[ok_other],
        alpha=0.25)
lines!(ax, t[ok_other], curves.mean_other[ok_other], linewidth=3, label="all others")

ylims!(ax, 0, 1)
axislegend(ax, position=:rb)

fig
```
